subject: BrightLayer — follow-up: model mix, token volumes & target $/1M tokens
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Gonzalez <alex.gonzalez@brightlayer.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 08 Jun 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: BrightLayer — follow-up: model mix, token volumes & target $/1M tokens

Hi Alex — great call earlier. Quick recap and a few requests so we can put together a pilot pricing proposal: 

What we heard (TL;DR):
- Primary use: customer-facing chat (product troubleshooting + short guidance)
- Secondary: similarity embeddings for search/reranking and a small reranking flow for top-N results
- SLA: sub-300ms p95 for chat in US; elastic capacity needed for peak times

Requests / ask from your side to finalize pricing:
1) Estimated monthly token volumes (if you can split by model/purpose that’d be ideal) — we need both input and output token assumptions if available.
2) Target budget or target $/1M tokens (ballpark is fine) — this helps us propose an appropriate model mix and whether to recommend hosted vs dedicated.
3) Any compliance/contract constraints (PO timing, required terms) so we can align procurement early.

I attached a one-page mutual action plan and a quick token-estimate template to fill — see attachments & Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3cBrightLayerMAP

Next steps from Redwood: I’ll run a blended unit-cost estimate for the model mix you provide and propose two options: (1) pilot on hosted with trial credits and (2) 3-month reserved capacity (Dedicated) with pricing tiers.

If it helps, can you reply here with rough monthly volumes by model (chat / embeddings / rerank) and a target $/1M tokens? Even ranges are fine.

Thanks — looking forward.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
(415) 555-0182

Attachments: BrightLayer_MAP.xlsx (MAP), BrightLayer_token_estimates.xlsx (token worksheet)

From: Alex Gonzalez <alex.gonzalez@brightlayer.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan@brightlayer.com>
Date: Wed, 09 Jun 2027 09:37:00 -0400
Subject: Re: BrightLayer — follow-up: model mix, token volumes & target $/1M tokens

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the summary. Quick answers from our side (ballpark):

1) Estimated monthly tokens (total ~45M tokens / month):
   - Chat (primary): ~29M tokens (roughly 65% of total). Average 300 tokens per session (input+output).
   - Embeddings (search & similarity): ~13.5M tokens (30%). These are shorter calls but high throughput (we batch vectors).
   - Rerank (top-N scoring): ~2.25M tokens (5%).

2) Target budget / $/1M tokens: Ideally we'd like to be around $30–$40 per 1M tokens as a blended target. Open to a slightly higher rate for chat if embeddings are cheaper — looking for an overall blended price in that range.

3) Procurement timing: We have a standard PO process — procurement will want an SOW and an initial pilot order. Jordan (cc'd) will own procurement/PO. We typically execute pilot POs within 4–6 weeks after terms are agreed.

I attached a quick estimate file we used internally. Happy to hop on a 20-min call if you want to walk through the traffic patterns.

—Alex
Alex Gonzalez
Head of Product
BrightLayer
alex.gonzalez@brightlayer.com
(617) 555-0123

Attachment: BrightLayer_internal_estimates.xlsx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Gonzalez <alex.gonzalez@brightlayer.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: BrightLayer — follow-up: model mix, token volumes & target $/1M tokens

Alex — this is great, thanks for the clarity. Ballpark economics and one recommended path below based on your ~45M token mix.

Blended estimate (rough):
- Proposed unit pricing (per 1M tokens):
  • Chat (general-purpose conversational model): $33 / 1M tokens
  • Embeddings (vector gen): $18 / 1M tokens
  • Rerank (scoring model): $14 / 1M tokens

- Applied to your split (29M chat / 13.5M embeddings / 2.25M rerank):
  • Chat cost: (29 * $33) = $957 / month (per 1M unit * 29 = $957) — NOTE: this is shorthand for 29M tokens * price-per-1M
  • Embeddings cost: (13.5 * $18) = $243
  • Rerank cost: (2.25 * $14) = $31.5
  • Blended monthly cost ≈ $1,231.5 -> blended $/1M tokens ≈ ($1,231.5 / 45) ≈ $27.36 per 1M tokens

That blended number lands inside your $30–$40 target, and we can tighten further with a 3-month reserved commit or by optimizing batching/quantization for embeddings.

Recommended next steps:
1) Quick internal alignment call (15–20m) next week to confirm peak patterns and SLA expectations — Rafael (cc'd) can run the technical Q&A.
2) I’ll put together a formal pilot commercial (hosted pilot + optional upgrade path to Dedicated) and drop a one-page SOW + pricing in DocuSign for your procurement.
3) If procurement is ready to move, Jordan can share the PO template and target dates; we’ll align on a pilot start date.

If that looks good I’ll share a short pricing SOW by EOD Friday.

Best,
Marissa
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
(415) 555-0182
